scoring: Editorial prioritization for a reproducible laptop foundation; not measured performance.
scale: 1=weak/expensive;5=strong/practical. Research-grade is planned scope, not current maturity.

projects.title: Generic vertical landing feedback
projects.problem: Measure how sampled feedback changes contact velocity in a one-axis descent, while distinguishing controller performance from numerical contact handling.
projects.mathematical_model: $\dot h=v,\ \dot v=u-g$, with $u=\operatorname{clip}(g+k_p(h_* - h)-k_d v,0,u_{max})$. SI units; constant mass. Held acceleration gives $h(t+\Delta t)=h+v\Delta t+a\Delta t^2/2$.
projects.implementation: A frozen configuration feeds the sampled controller, analytic ballistic segment integrator, contact detector and result recorder. The below-surface virtual setpoint gives contact rather than asymptotic hover. It is not a target penetration command for hardware.
projects.validation: Free fall must match its closed-form contact time and speed. Nominal contact must occur within 90 s with speed below 1 m/s. Halving the 20 ms step must change contact speed by less than 0.02 m/s. Report all 50 scenario draws, including failures.
projects.demonstrable_output: Height and velocity traces, contact metrics, unpowered baseline and seeded scenario CSV.
projects.limitations: No variable mass, drag, engine ignition, minimum throttle, gimbal dynamics, sensors or landing legs. A successful test cannot establish a Falcon 9 landing envelope.
projects.future_improvements: Add actuator lag and sensor bias before 2D motion; then compare controller designs under the same constraints. Implement constrained guidance as a separate project.

projects.title: Kalman navigation with observation outage
projects.problem: Estimate position and velocity from noisy position samples, and quantify what happens when observations are unavailable.
projects.mathematical_model: $x_{k+1}=Fx_k+Ga_k+w_k$, $F=[[1,\Delta t],[0,1]]$, $G=[\Delta t^2/2,\Delta t]^T$, $z_k=Hx_k+v_k$, $H=[1,0]$. $Q=\sigma_a^2GG^T$, $R=\sigma_z^2$.
projects.implementation: A seeded truth generator is separate from the estimator. The estimator consumes only noisy observations, known acceleration commands and its prior. Prediction continues during40–50 s observation loss; Joseph-form covariance updates occur only when a measurement exists.
projects.validation: Check covariance symmetry and positive semidefiniteness. Confirm uncertainty increases during prediction-only outage. Compare errors on identical available timestamps after 10 s, over 30 seeds; separately report outage error. Do not choose a favorable seed.
projects.demonstrable_output: Estimate/error/covariance CSV, error plot and matched multi-seed RMSE comparison.
projects.limitations: Matched Gaussian noise and process model; no calibrated IMU, bias states, time synchronization or real GNSS. A lower simulated RMSE does not establish operational navigation accuracy.
projects.future_improvements: Add bias and timing errors, tune on a separate seed set, then evaluate NIS/NEES and an EKF with independent sensor models.

projects.title: Two-body orbit and synthetic constellation coverage
projects.problem: Verify orbital propagation against an analytic circular orbit and measure geometric visibility for a chosen ground station.
projects.mathematical_model: $\ddot{\mathbf r}=-\mu\mathbf r/\|\mathbf r\|^3$, $T=2\pi\sqrt{r^3/\mu}$. Elevation uses $\sin e=(\boldsymbol\rho\cdot\hat{\mathbf u})/\|\boldsymbol\rho\|$, where $\boldsymbol\rho$ is station-to-satellite displacement.
projects.implementation: DOP853 propagates a synthetic Cartesian state. A separate circular-shell generator creates6 planes of 12 satellites, rotates them into a simplified Earth-fixed frame and applies a 25-degree elevation mask at−7.25°,112.75°.
projects.validation: Over two periods, require analytic position error below 1 m and relative energy/angular-momentum drift below 1e-8. Check overhead/horizon geometry and monotonicity when the mask is lowered. Coverage is a sampled fraction, not a continuous-time guarantee.
projects.demonstrable_output: Orbit plot, state/analytic error CSV and a one-day sampled visibility trace.
projects.limitations: Spherical Earth, constant rotation phase, no J2, drag, real epoch, access scheduling or traffic.72 chosen satellites are not the current Starlink constellation. No TLE/OMM import is implemented.
projects.future_improvements: Add time-resolution convergence, geodetic frames and a separately validated OMM/SGP4 adapter; only then add network queues and routing.

projects.title: Lumped cryogenic thermal warmup
projects.problem: Build and verify a heat-balance baseline before introducing tank pressure or phase change.
projects.mathematical_model: $C\dot T=UA(T_a-T)$, $T(t)=T_a+(T_0-T_a)e^{-UA t/C}$. Stored energy is $C(T-T_0)$ and heat flow is $UA(T_a-T)$.
projects.implementation: An abstract effective thermal body starts at90 K with ambient120 K, capacity200000 J/K and conductance5 W/K. Numerical integration is compared with the exponential solution over 7200 s. These are chosen effective inputs, not measured fluid properties.
projects.validation: Maximum analytic error below 1e-6 K; integrated heat versus stored energy relative mismatch below 1e-5. Check equilibrium and cooling as separate limiting cases. Require a pressure/fluid-dependent phase boundary before extending into a real tank model.
projects.demonstrable_output: Temperature/heat-flow curves, energy balance and numerical residuals.
projects.limitations: Only sensible heat in an abstract lump. No fluid identity, saturation pressure, wall capacitance, latent heat, radiation or slosh; no boil-off prediction. The94.94 K output is not a validated real propellant state.
projects.future_improvements: Add separate wall/liquid nodes and validated property tables, then phase-change events and mass conservation. Compare to a public dataset before claiming tank fidelity.

projects.title: Sensor voting and latched fault response
projects.problem: Exercise nominal, degraded and safe states under explicit sensor faults, including what the voter cannot detect.
projects.mathematical_model: For three scalar readings, $\hat x=\operatorname{median}(z_1,z_2,z_3)$. With two healthy readings, the median lies between them. This bound does not hold for common-mode corruption of the healthy pair.
projects.implementation: Synthetic sensors feed a finite-value and agreement check. Three agreeing values are NOMINAL; an agreeing pair is DEGRADED; missing data or no agreeing pair is SAFE. SAFE latches and suppresses estimates until an explicit reset at45 s with healthy input.
projects.validation: Test one arbitrary outlier, three-way disagreement, missing/NaN data, safe-output suppression and reset semantics. Include a passing-through common-mode corruption test to expose the limitation.250 SAFE samples describe this script, not a reliability estimate.
projects.demonstrable_output: Time-aligned sensor traces, state-transition timeline and fault/event CSV.
projects.limitations: No radiation, hardware voter, bus, watchdog timing or real-time scheduling. Two agreeing bad sensors can defeat the policy. This is not Byzantine consensus or flight-certified software.
projects.future_improvements: Add timestamps/staleness, independent voter monitoring and property-based event sequences; port a small component to F Prime only after the behavior is specified.

projects.title: Launch trajectory transcription
projects.problem: Find a feasible ascent in an original reduced-order model with an explicit terminal target.
projects.mathematical_model: Point-mass states $[h,v,m]$ obey force balance and $\dot m=-T/(I_{sp}g_0)$; optimize a declared control history and objective under bounds.
projects.implementation: Use Dymos or CasADi after verifying the force model; begin with a vertical vacuum case and a small mesh.
projects.validation: Reintegrate controls outside the optimizer, report terminal errors, constraint violations and mesh convergence; solver success alone fails acceptance.
projects.demonstrable_output: Trajectory, mass/control histories and feasibility residuals.
projects.limitations: No claimed SpaceX ascent profile; thrust, drag and atmosphere uncertainties dominate fidelity.
projects.future_improvements: Introduce2D motion, parameter uncertainty and launch-site constraints in separately reviewed steps.

projects.title: Successive-convexification powered descent
projects.problem: Reproduce an accessible academic guidance formulation before adapting its assumptions.
projects.mathematical_model: Nonlinear rigid-body dynamics are linearized into sequential convex subproblems with trust regions and virtual controls.
projects.implementation: Implement the normalized published case, explicit nondimensionalization and constraint handling; pin solver and transcription versions.
projects.validation: Reproduce paper conditions, independently integrate the nonlinear system, check residual virtual control and test infeasible cases and multiple meshes.
projects.demonstrable_output: Convergence traces,6 DOF trajectory and constraint residual plots.
projects.limitations: Research-grade scope refers to methodology, not implemented maturity. Runtime depends on solver and mesh. No SpaceX control law is released.
projects.future_improvements: Study aerodynamic constraints only after the baseline reproduces the paper.

projects.title: Methalox equilibrium sensitivity
projects.problem: Compare equilibrium composition and thermodynamic outputs across documented boundary conditions.
projects.mathematical_model: Constrained Gibbs-energy minimization enforces element balances; distinguish equilibrium from frozen expansion assumptions.
projects.implementation: Wrap NASA CEA or Cantera in a versioned input/output adapter; use published example problems before educational sweeps.
projects.validation: Close element and energy balances, reproduce a documented regression case and record mechanism/database versions.
projects.demonstrable_output: Temperature/species/sensitivity plots and reproducible input deck.
projects.limitations: Equilibrium chemistry is not combustion stability, heat flux, engine life or full Raptor performance.
projects.future_improvements: Cross-compare packages using the same species and thermodynamic assumptions.

projects.title: Generic rocket-cycle balance graph
projects.problem: Compare gas-generator and full-flow topologies without inventing internal engine parameters.
projects.mathematical_model: Stream mass/enthalpy balances plus pump/turbine shaft-power residuals define a graph model; efficiencies are explicitly assumed.
projects.implementation: Build an original zero-dimensional component graph and a normalized example, separating topology from calibrated component maps.
projects.validation: Close all mass, energy and shaft balances; flag underdetermined parameter sets and sensitivity to assumed efficiencies.
projects.demonstrable_output: Flow graph, balance residuals and normalized sensitivity chart.
projects.limitations: Not a Raptor or Merlin reconstruction; missing component maps prevent validated performance prediction.
projects.future_improvements: Add an independently licensed published engine benchmark if complete boundary conditions become available.

projects.title: Reentry point-mass sensitivity
projects.problem: Study how an explicitly assumed drag law changes a generic atmospheric descent.
projects.mathematical_model: $D=\rho v^2 C_D A/2$ and point-mass dynamics couple velocity and altitude; any heating law is a separately sourced approximation.
projects.implementation: Start with a nonlifting model and exponential atmosphere; add uncertainty bands instead of a single apparently exact path.
projects.validation: Check vacuum and zero-drag limits, step refinement and dimensional consistency; compare only with a published benchmark using matching assumptions.
projects.demonstrable_output: Altitude/speed/load histories and parameter sensitivity.
projects.limitations: No Starship belly-flop, flap coefficients, ablation chemistry or validated hypersonic aerodynamics.
projects.future_improvements: Add independently validated lift and heating models with explicit applicability limits.

projects.title: Attitude and thrust-vector control comparison
projects.problem: Compare PID and LQR around the same generic attitude operating point.
projects.mathematical_model: $I\ddot\theta=\tau$, with actuator saturation and optional first-order lag. Linearization and gain units must be explicit.
projects.implementation: Begin with a one-axis rigid body and independent actuator model; compare identical disturbances, sensors and actuator limits.
projects.validation: Check inertia/torque units, closed-loop poles, step-response bounds and saturation recovery; add Monte Carlo variations.
projects.demonstrable_output: Angle/control histories, settling-time and effort comparisons.
projects.limitations: No flight-qualified gains or specific gimbal geometry; an MPC extension remains separately scoped.
projects.future_improvements: Extend to quaternion kinematics with norm checks and frame-convention tests.

projects.title: Grid-fin control-effectiveness study
projects.problem: Separate low-speed aerodynamic learning from claims about operational grid fins.
projects.mathematical_model: A local surrogate $C_m=C_{m0}+C_{m\alpha}\alpha+C_{m\delta}\delta$ is valid only within a documented fit domain.
projects.implementation: Use an original simple lifting surface for an analytic/AVL baseline; a real grid-fin CFD model requires a new validated dataset and mesh study.
projects.validation: Compare analytic lift behavior, refinement and withheld fit cases; reject extrapolation beyond the sampled domain.
projects.demonstrable_output: Control-effectiveness maps with validity masks.
projects.limitations: AVL is not a hypersonic grid-fin solver; no SpaceX aerodynamic database or flight coefficients.
projects.future_improvements: Acquire a legally reusable public wind-tunnel benchmark before studying compressible grid fins.

projects.title: Analytic-to-FEA structural benchmark
projects.problem: Verify a structural workflow using a beam before modeling complex geometry.
projects.mathematical_model: For a slender cantilever, tip deflection $\delta=PL^3/(3EI)$; check reactions and strain energy.
projects.implementation: Build original beam geometry and a small finite-element mesh with DOLFINx or a suitable FreeCAD workbench.
projects.validation: Match analytic deflection, force balance and mesh-convergence trend; record element type and boundary conditions.
projects.demonstrable_output: Deflection field, convergence plot and validation report.
projects.limitations: Linear beam success does not validate rocket shell buckling, cryogenic welds or fatigue.
projects.future_improvements: Add buckling benchmarks, then thermal stresses with temperature-dependent properties.

projects.title: Monte Carlo flight dispersion harness
projects.problem: Measure model sensitivity across a declared distribution instead of selecting attractive trials.
projects.mathematical_model: For outputs $y=f(x)$, propagate explicitly stated parameter distributions; distinguish aleatory variation from model uncertainty.
projects.implementation: Wrap an existing validated model with seed recording, failed-run retention and incremental summaries.
projects.validation: Use analytic linear uncertainty propagation as a benchmark; report sample size, quantiles, failure counts and convergence.
projects.demonstrable_output: Dispersion plots and replayable trial records.
projects.limitations: Assumed distributions are not empirical SpaceX reliability data; tails need more than a small sample.
projects.future_improvements: Add sensitivity screening and separate model-form uncertainty.

projects.title: Inter-satellite routing experiment
projects.problem: Compare shortest paths and disrupted routes on a time-varying synthetic constellation.
projects.mathematical_model: Edges require geometric line of sight; propagation delay is path length divided by light speed. Queue delay is a separate model.
projects.implementation: Begin with graph snapshots fromL03; use Hypatia/ns-3 only for the packet-level extension.
projects.validation: Check Earth obstruction, path connectivity, symmetry assumptions and delay lower bounds; hold traffic scenarios constant.
projects.demonstrable_output: Route animation, outage timeline and latency-component comparison.
projects.limitations: No Starlink routing protocol inferred; propagation-only delay is not measured internet RTT.
projects.future_improvements: Introduce congestion and handovers with pinned packet-simulator settings.

projects.title: Orbital rendezvous state-machine study
projects.problem: Connect relative-motion estimation to staged approach/hold/abort logic in an educational mission.
projects.mathematical_model: Begin with two independently propagated Cartesian orbits; subtract positions in a explicitly defined frame before any relative-motion linearization.
projects.implementation: Build a state machine with approach corridors and bounded commands using synthetic initial conditions.
projects.validation: Compare relative and absolute formulations, check frame transforms and exercise abort/hold transitions.
projects.demonstrable_output: Relative trajectory and state-transition report.
projects.limitations: No Dragon perception stack, ISS procedure or autonomous docking certification.
projects.future_improvements: Add a sourced relative-motion model and estimator timing errors.

projects.title: Synthetic telemetry anomaly detection
projects.problem: Evaluate whether a model detects defined injected faults beyond a simple threshold baseline.
projects.mathematical_model: Use time-window features and an explicitly defined anomaly score; split complete runs before fitting any normalization.
projects.implementation: Generate labeled operating modes and faults; compare thresholds against a small statistical or ML detector.
projects.validation: Hold out whole scenarios, prevent time-window leakage, report precision/recall and delay by fault type, and retain false positives.
projects.demonstrable_output: Detection timeline, confusion counts and unseen-scenario report.
projects.limitations: Synthetic separability does not establish predictive maintenance on rocket engines; no remaining-useful-life truth exists.
projects.future_improvements: Only add real data after rights, labels, operating domains and independent evaluation are established.

projects.title: Reusable-vehicle model integration workbench
projects.problem: Combine separately verified toy subsystems while exposing coupling and timing assumptions.
projects.mathematical_model: Explicit interface contracts specify state, units, sample rates, causality and conservation residuals across subsystem boundaries.
projects.implementation: IntegrateL01,L02,L04,L05 incrementally with recorded interface signals and replayable experiments.
projects.validation: Check each component independently, then add one coupling at a time and validate conservation/latency assumptions.
projects.demonstrable_output: Integrated timeline and interface-validation report.
projects.limitations: Call this a simulation workbench until synchronized real-asset data exist; it is not an operational digital twin.
projects.future_improvements: Add co-simulation only for a concrete coupling risk, with an independent baseline.

projects.title: Phased-array beam pattern explorer
projects.problem: Explore generic array geometry and steering without modeling a proprietary terminal.
projects.mathematical_model: $AF(\theta)=\sum_n w_n e^{j k d_n\sin\theta}$ for idealized elements; normalize pattern power explicitly.
projects.implementation: Implement an original uniform linear-array model with steering and amplitude-taper controls.
projects.validation: Check broadside symmetry, known nulls and steering-sign conventions; distinguish array factor from total antenna gain.
projects.demonstrable_output: Polar pattern and sidelobe/beamwidth comparison.
projects.limitations: No Starlink RF chip, element pattern, calibration, coupling or actual terminal gain data.
projects.future_improvements: Add a separately sourced antenna-theory reference and measured public benchmark before quantitative gain claims.

projects.title: Manufacturing tolerance propagation
projects.problem: Connect geometric and material variation to a simple structural response.
projects.mathematical_model: Propagate chosen tolerances through a beam stiffness or mass model; sensitivities follow explicit derivatives and unit checks.
projects.implementation: UseL13 original geometry and synthetic parameter distributions, then compare linear approximation to sampled results.
projects.validation: Verify zero-variance and small-variation limits; document distribution assumptions and keep parameter correlations explicit.
projects.demonstrable_output: Tolerance-response distributions and sensitivity ranking.
projects.limitations: No SpaceX welding/printing process parameters or production quality data. A simulation does not qualify manufacturing.
projects.future_improvements: Replace synthetic distributions only with permissioned measured data and documented metrology.

projects.title: Two-tank cryogenic transfer balance
projects.problem: Verify bookkeeping and thermal coupling in a generic two-reservoir transfer.
projects.mathematical_model: $\dot m_1=-\dot m$, $\dot m_2=\dot m$; energy balances carry inlet/outlet enthalpy plus heat flow.
projects.implementation: Start with a prescribed transfer rate and sensible-heat states; add phase behavior only after conservation tests.
projects.validation: Conserve total mass, close energy, test zero-flow/equal-temperature limits and avoid negative inventories.
projects.demonstrable_output: Mass/temperature histories and balance residuals.
projects.limitations: No microgravity slosh, venting, ullage dynamics, line transients or Starship ship-to-ship refueling demonstration.
projects.future_improvements: Add fluid properties, events and a published public transfer benchmark.

projects.title: Launch-window geometry explorer
projects.problem: Relate Earth rotation, orbital-plane geometry and a chosen launch-site latitude.
projects.mathematical_model: Compute site position in a declared inertial frame and evaluate plane-angle error versus elapsed time.
projects.implementation: ReuseL03 frame conventions and synthetic target planes; report geometric opportunities only.
projects.validation: Check symmetry and repeatability after one sidereal day; compare vector geometry with an independent trigonometric case.
projects.demonstrable_output: Window-angle plot and constraint trace.
projects.limitations: No operational launch clearance, collision screening, weather, range constraints or trajectory feasibility.
projects.future_improvements: Add independently sourced mission constraints without conflating geometry with executable launch windows.
